findings.question: Q4
findings.title: Retained history hashes raw entries instead of canonical owner-normalized entries
findings.smallest_reproduction: Following reader baseline empty ledger. Publicly construct a replacement ledger with BudgetCharge realized=1 and from_general_pool=1 (integers), interrupt before its _account read-back, then restore through BudgetLedger.from_dict and read again.
findings.actual_result: Statically: retained raw JSON hashes integer 1; regular owner read-back hashes float 1.0. Recovery installs raw hash into _seen and then declares the canonical unchanged checkpoint rewritten, permanently diverged. NOT RUN.
findings.expected_result: Unchanged canonical checkpoint recovers; interruption does not establish corruption.
findings.proposed_correction: Use the exact canonical owner normalization and JSON round-trip for retained entries, with integer-field and other normalization recovery controls.
findings.trust_boundary: Public owner constructors and restore; no private accounting mutation.

findings.question: Q4
findings.title: Interruption before native retention loses handed spend and permits later restored acceptance
findings.smallest_reproduction: Admit at S0; execute and settle S1; accounts returns S1 in valid plain dicts; one KeyboardInterrupt at line 975/976 before _uncompared assignment; catch and publicly restore S0; dispatch previous admitted action. Related path: interrupt initial native capture and recovery before entry copying; mutate live dict entry to restored S0 before deferred recovery.
findings.actual_result: Statically: no retained S1 barrier exists, _leave removes ticket, later S0 equals seen state and can re-admit/redispatch. Duplicate execution NOT RUN by this lens.
findings.expected_result: A returned handed state remains an unresolved/recoverable obligation before later acceptance; no forgetting spend on interruption.
findings.proposed_correction: Make acquisition/retention and exceptional exit recoverable; add pre-registration/capture/recovery checkpoints and executor-call controls. If mutable callback information is insufficient, explicitly choose a retained immutable owner handoff published into a pre-registered slot and acknowledged after comparison; do not permanently poison an honest reader.
findings.trust_boundary: Public dict handing, operator interruption and public checkpoint restore. Handed spend, not wholly-between-verifications rollback.

findings.question: Q4
findings.title: Separate interrupted detached handings falsely establish rewritten history
findings.smallest_reproduction: Stable ledger with one settled charge; accounts returns fresh public from_dict copies. Two separate pins each interrupt _handed once after capture and let recovery complete; next pin succeeds in execution but is refused permanently.
findings.actual_result: Statically: first recovery records U1; second recovery sees canonically equal U2 with distinct entry identities and _note_unread marks _diverged before canonical reconciliation. NOT RUN.
findings.expected_result: Finite interruptions of unchanged detached state may refuse transiently but never establish corruption or permanent retirement.
findings.proposed_correction: Keep distinct native observations unresolved and reconcile their canonical owner histories outside lock before equality/divergence; apply only to identical pending barriers. Add repeated detached interruption controls plus true-spend contrasts.
findings.trust_boundary: Public detached checkpoints and external interruption; no private mutation.
